commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List Docker Hub image categories. Their slugs are the --category values for search-category-images.

commands.name: search-category-images
commands.summary: Search repositories within one category by keyword, with filters for product type and trust badge, a sort order and page number.

commands.name: get-official-image
commands.summary: Get details of a Docker Official Image (library/*), such as nginx: description, categories, pull count, stars, last updated date and full overview (full_description).

commands.name: list-official-image-tags
commands.summary: List the tags of a Docker Official Image, with a name filter, sort order and page number. Includes the tag digest, size, last update and per-architecture images (architecture, os, digest, size).

commands.name: get-repository
commands.summary: Get details of a community or verified-publisher repository such as grafana/grafana: description, pull count, stars, categories, last updated date and full overview (full_description).

commands.name: list-repository-tags
commands.summary: List the tags of a non-official repository (namespace/repo), with a name filter, sort order and page number. Includes digest, size, last update and per-architecture images.

commands.name: get-image-layers
commands.summary: Get details of one tag's image: per-architecture digests, sizes, last pulled date and the Dockerfile layer commands.

commands.name: get-image-vulnerabilities
commands.summary: Get the Docker Scout vulnerability counts (critical/high/medium/low/unspecified/total) and SBOM state for an image digest.

commands.name: get-organization
commands.summary: Get public info for a Docker Hub organization or namespace: full name, company, location, website, join date and verified-publisher badge.

commands.name: list-publisher-repositories
commands.summary: List the public repositories a publisher or user owns, with a name search, sort order and page number.

commands.name: search-mcp-servers
commands.summary: Search the Docker MCP Catalog of containerized MCP servers by keyword, optionally filtered by category.

commands.name: get-mcp-server
commands.summary: Get details of an MCP catalog server: description, image, source repo, readme/tools URLs and config.

commands.name: list-mcp-server-tools
commands.summary: List the tools an MCP catalog server exposes, with their names and descriptions.
